summary: Iteration-2 focused testing on new endpoints and UI: reserved workflow, bulk units, Excel exports, logo upload, public branding, top_vendors. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test_iter2.py — 19/19 tests passing (public settings, bulk create with pad+skip+cap+RBAC, reserve/release/sell-clears-reservation/reserve-sold-400/RBAC, all 4 exports, logo upload+public download+admin-only, top_vendors shape). Frontend: verified with seeded admin session — login shows updated TestCo branding + red logo, sidebar shows company+logo, Units page Export dropdown lists Excel & PDF, Bulk Create dialog opens with all inputs, Dashboard top-vendors tile renders after seeding 2 approved expenses, Settings logo file input + preview present. Expenses & Revenue pages both expose Export button.

minor.issue: Cap check is `end - start > 500` which allows 501 units per call (off-by-one from the stated 500-unit cap). Change to `end - start + 1 > 500`.

Endpoint accepts status 'reserved' as valid pre-condition (per spec), so an already-reserved unit can be re-reserved (overwrites buyer/until). Spec says 'rejects if unit not available/reserved' which matches implementation — but this permits silently changing buyer. Consider requiring release first for clarity.
For non-public files, expired-session check is missing (only checks session exists, not expires_at). Get_current_user handles it elsewhere but here it's inline auth.

ui_bugs.issue: No Export button/dropdown rendered — spec required Excel export UI for Stock page. Backend /api/exports/stock works and returns xlsx; UI is missing the trigger.

issues: Radix DialogContent components lack aria-describedby (console warnings on Bulk Create, Sell, Reserve dialogs). Add DialogDescription for a11y.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings persist from iteration 1 despite minHeight — appears on first paint of hidden containers, harmless.

action_items: Add Export dropdown (Excel + optional PDF) to /app/frontend/src/pages/Stock.jsx (or Stock Book file) wired to downloadExcel('/exports/stock', ...). Mirror pattern from Units.jsx.
Optional: fix off-by-one in bulk cap check (`end - start > 500` -> `end - start + 1 > 500`).
Optional: silence Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warnings by adding <DialogDescription> to Bulk/Sell/Reserve dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: download_file inline auth path does not verify expires_at like get_current_user does — an expired session_token would still allow non-public file download. Reuse get_current_user via Optional dep instead of inline logic.
bulk_create_units: `end - start > 500` allows 501-unit calls (fencepost). Fix to `end - start + 1 > 500`.

reserve_unit accepts status='reserved' so an admin can silently swap the buyer_name on an already-reserved unit without release audit trail. Consider enforcing release-then-reserve or capturing 'previous_buyer' in audit meta.
dashboard_summary now does a single async-for pass over expenses which is good — earlier double-iteration comment is resolved.
Stock export endpoint exists but Stock.jsx UI does not expose it — frontend/backend feature parity gap.
